[quote=qianxun;60269220][b]Ceasing warfare and promoting benevolence[/b][/quote]

[b]Democratic-held airbase "Kuwalkti"[/b]

General Haru Arono sits in the control tower of Kuwalkti airbase, captured by Democratic forces last week. Haru was originally a colonel in the Astanir army, but defected and took part in the Astan protests that marked the beginning of the Democratic factions fight. He has since quickly risen up the ranks and solidified his name as the leader of Astanirs Democratic Movement in the civil war. He now sits contemplating what the future will bring for the country, just as the control panel begins making rapid beeping noises.

[i]"Sir, we are recieving a radio transmission from an unknown source in Amaralo. Our technicians are estimating that the signal is coming from within Qianxun, but these systems arent powerful enough to confirm.
"Patch it through to the bunker"
"Yes sir"[/i]

Haru would make his way down various sets of stairs and underground tunnels to a makeshift bunker situated underneath the airbase. It had been hastily constructed over the past week of Democratic occupation of the airbase as a series secret storage areas, communications rooms and meeting places. 

Haru would eventually make his way to a mostly empty room, illuminated only a a dim lamp. In the Center of the room is a table, with various pieces of radio equipment sprawled across it. Wires creep along the floor throughout the room and into the surrounding corridors like vines. The general pulls up a chair from the back of the room, places the headset on his skull, places the microphone in front of him and flicks the switch.

[i]"Hello? This is General Haru Arono speaking, what do you want"[/i]

(OOC: not including the actual conversation here since idk how qianxuns characters would speak)

The call would last for over an hour, with armed guards keeping the door locked for the entire length of the procedure. After the call had successfully concluded, Haru would order the guards to step aside as he hastily made his way back through the tunnel system towards another room in the subterranean network.

Upon arriving in the meeting room he would be greeted with the familiar faces of the Democratic council, the body he had set up for helping him lead the alliance. Seated around a circular metal table would be various ex-military personnel and fierce activists turned fighters.

[i]"Thank you for coming here once again everyone, I have some very important news to share,"[/i]
[i]"Spill the beans Haru, who was that on the radio?"[/i]
[i]"Diplomats from Qianxun over on Amaralo, they want to initiate relations with us. Aid, weapons, all that lovely stuff,"
"Interesting, interesting, are you sure we can trust these people?"
"TRUST? Of course we cant trust them! They have contacted us after a month. A WHOLE MONTH!"
"The crazy man has a point, if they were this eager to get aid to us, they surely wouldnt have waited this long? They couldve easily airdropped food and medical supplies right from the start,"
"Hey, put yourself on their shoes for a minute. This war couldve been over in a few weeks, in which case there would be no need to send supplies until the aftermath took its toll. It has now become evident that this war is going to be a long one, so theyve decided that aid is necessary at this point,"
"Exactly, so what if they waited a month? We need to take this opportunity whilst we have it, any support can help us get this over with as quickly as possible,"
"And what if this isnt support? This is manipulation and I can smell it! They are simply another interventionist power poking their nose into other peoples business and exploiting them,"
"Watch it! Youre starting to sound like the loners and the junties"[/i]
(OOC: loners = slang for the National army of Astanir coming from their isolationist policy, junties = the armed restoration front coming from their military junta style government)
[i]"Dont compare me to those disgusting fascists!"[/i]
[i]"Calm down everyone! We need to reach a decision on this fast. ALL IN FAVOUR RAISE YOUR HAND"[/i]

17/25 raised hands.

[i]"Well I suppose that decides it, Ill try and get back in contact with them, dismissed."[/i]

Later that day, the democrats would send an encoded telegram back to the Qianxun diplomats approving Qianxun diplomats to fly to Astanir by plane to meet in-person with Haru and his fighters.

OOC: sorry if this is kinda ass, character RP is not my strong suit. Also, I deliberately left out who was taking during the meeting to make it more mysterious, let me know if it doesnt work
